BAILEY PAIRS, EICHLER INTEGRALS AND UNIFIED
WITTEN-RESHETIKHIN-TURAEV INVARIANTS
JEREMY LOVEJOY, ROBERT OSBURN, AND MATTHIAS STORZER
Abstract. In 1999, Lawrence and Zagier expressed the Witten-Reshetikhin-Turaev (WRT)
invariant of the Poincar´e homology sphere as the limiting value of the Eichler integral of a
weight 3/2 modular form. Habiro’s construction of the unified WRT invariant subsequently
recast this result as an identity for a q-hypergeometric series at roots of unity. This motivated
Hikami to prove analogous q-series identities involving the unified WRT invariants of certain

blocks.title: Preliminaries and auxiliary results
An arsenal of Bailey pairs
The key results
blocks.content: Here we state and prove the key results relating ([\[h1\]](#h1){reference-type="ref" reference="h1"}), ([\[h8\]](#h8){reference-type="ref" reference="h8"}), ([\[h2\]](#h2){reference-type="ref" reference="h2"})--([\[h7\]](#h7){reference-type="ref" reference="h7"}), ([\[h9\]](#h9){reference-type="ref" reference="h9"}) and ([\[h10\]](#h10){reference-type="ref" reference="h10"}) to finite polynomial sums at roots of unity. We have chosen to present these results following the order in which the Bailey pairs in Section [\[arseBP\]](#arseBP){reference-type="ref" reference="arseBP"} were introduced.
